Verge.name: The Verge
Verge.text: Frontier worlds, farms, freeports, escorts and working ships shaped by unreliable connection, famine memory and practical autonomy. Green is the regional color grammar; cargo, food, repairs, route knowledge and sworn bargains matter more than ceremonial authority.

Corridors.name: Auric corridor space
Corridors.text: The thin transit approaches linking Luminara and Auric Freeport through the Auric Gate: mineral haze, unstable visibility, fortress debris and contested passage. Movement, timing and control of the route determine whether civilian cargo arrives.
